big_case.notes: Overruling Libretti v. United States (1995) to apply Apprendi and Southern Union to criminal forfeiture would alter federal sentencing procedure under Rule 32.2 across thousands of criminal forfeiture cases annually, and the petition drew two cert-stage amicus briefs (ten former federal judges; WLF/NACDL/DPI/NAPD) plus a Court-requested response after an initial SG waiver. However, the petition sought express overruling of settled Supreme Court precedent with zero circuit split, arose from a nonprecedential Second Circuit summary order on a multi-predicate trial record, repeated a question the Court had denied over a dozen times since Apprendi, and ended in a silent, single-post-BIO-conference denial.
